title: Lensterdam
tagline: Engaging push notifications for The Lens Protocol with EPNS, TheGraph and POAP

prizes.placement: 🧩 EPNS — Best Use of Backend SDK
prizes.title: EPNS

description: We bring you LensterDAM - a new and improved version of Lens Protocol and Lenster. It offers users the ability to view their POAPS on the social platform and opt into engaging push notifications when: 1. you have a new follower, 2. Somebody comments on your posts 3. your friends have created posts (every now and then)
how_its_made: We use EPNS's showrunners framework to gather data from Lens Protocol's smart contracts through Event filters and Graphql API to determine when notifications need to be sent, and consecutively gather all the data that is required to construct them. TheGraph is used to make POAP's visible on Lensterdam and EPNS's frontend-SDK has been used to allow users to opt into the push notifications through EPNS.
